plugins.name: api-security-automation
plugins.description: Automate API security directly in Claude Code with 42Crunch—audit OpenAPI specs, scan for OWASP API vulnerabilities (including BOLA/BFLA), and apply AI-powered fixes. Designed for AI-assisted development workflows, it delivers continuous security guardrails through an audit→scan→remediate→validate loop, ensuring APIs meet enterprise compliance standards before deployment.
